intro: A broken garage door spring makes your door heavy or unusable. This is a common issue for Berwyn homeowners. Many homes in the Depot District and South Berwyn still have their original detached alley garages. These older systems work hard. Daily use and Chicago weather cycles weaken springs over time. When a spring breaks, you might hear a loud bang. The door won't open, or it will feel extremely heavy. Our technicians replace broken springs with durable parts. We offer upfront flat-rate quotes before any work begins. We stock common parts on our trucks for efficient service. Our team is available 24 hours Monday through Saturday for urgent repairs. We get your Berwyn garage door working safely again.
localContext: Berwyn is home to many Chicago-style brick bungalows. Most of these were built in the 1920s. They feature detached alley garages. These garages often still run their first or second-generation hardware. Springs on these older doors have endured decades of use. They also contend with significant temperature shifts common in Cook County. Cold winters make metal brittle. Hot summers can cause expansion. This stress leads to spring fatigue and eventual breakage. Additionally, these garages were built for narrower Model T-era vehicles. Modern SUVs and trucks often stress old systems, especially with worn rollers or bent track. Replacing an old, broken spring restores safe operation, especially important near busy areas like the Cermak Road corridor.

problemSigns.detail: The spring no longer provides the necessary lift assistance.

problemSigns.detail: A clear sign of a broken torsion spring.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: Often means the spring is weak or only partially functional.
This happens when the spring loses tension, releasing the cables.
